# looker_permission_set (Data Source)

Looks up a Looker permission set by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "looker_permission_set" "example" {
  name = "Viewer Plus"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the permission set. Matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (Set of String)
